1.text: Akira came directly, breaking all tradition.
1.lessonText: Akira came directly, breaking all tradition.

clauses.text: Akira came directly, breaking all tradition.

notes: breaking 的逻辑主语是 Akira。directly 结合后文指不经媒人亲自来提亲，不只是说话坦率或行动迅速。

clauses.text: Was that it?

notes: that 回指直接登门这件事；it 指使 Chie 作出这种反应的原因。这是叙述中的反思设问。

3.text: Had he followed form—had he asked his mother to speak to his father to approach a go-between—would Chie have been more receptive?
3.lessonText: Had he followed form—had he asked his mother to speak to his father to approach a go-between—would Chie have been more receptive?
functions: to speak to his father to approach a go-between—

clauses.text: Had he followed form—had he asked his mother to speak to his father to approach a go-between—would Chie have been more receptive?
Had he followed form
had he asked his mother to speak to his father to approach a go-between

notes: Had he followed = If he had followed，是与过去事实相反的条件；主句又因提问将 would 前置。两种倒装来源不同。破折号内说明循礼的具体步骤，不是第二个结果主句。
两个 Had/had 条件结构分别标为 Conditional clause，第二个是破折号内的改述；if 只在省略提示中出现，理解时需还原正常语序。would 与 have been 属于外层问句谓语链。

4.text: He came on a winter's eve.
4.lessonText: He came on a winter's eve.

clauses.text: He came on a winter's eve.

notes: eve 在此为较文学的 evening“夜晚”，不是指定节日前夕。具体某个夜晚用 on。

5.text: He pounded on the door while a cold rain beat on the shuttered veranda, so at first Chie thought him only the wind.
5.lessonText: He pounded on the door while a cold rain beat on the shuttered veranda, so at first Chie thought him only the wind.

clauses.text: He pounded on the door while a cold rain beat on the shuttered veranda,
while a cold rain beat on the shuttered veranda,
so at first Chie thought him only the wind.

notes: think him the wind 为宾语＋名词宾补；实际是把来人的敲门动静当成风。while 表同时发生，so 连接结果主句；thought 后并无 that 从句。

clauses.text: The maid knew better.

notes: know better 表知道实情、不会误判，承接 Chie 把动静当风；不是泛指女佣学历更高。

7.text: Chie heard her soft scuttling footsteps, the creak of the door.
7.lessonText: Chie heard her soft scuttling footsteps, the creak of the door.

clauses.text: Chie heard her soft scuttling footsteps, the creak of the door.

notes: 两个声音名词短语并列作 heard 的宾语。scuttling 修饰 footsteps，并不是独立谓语。

8.text: Then the maid brought a calling card to the drawing room, for Chie.
8.lessonText: Then the maid brought a calling card to the drawing room, for Chie.

clauses.text: Then the maid brought a calling card to the drawing room, for Chie.

notes: to 引出送到的地点，for 引出给谁。calling card 为拜访名片，drawing room 为客厅，不按字面译“绘画房间”。

9.text: Chie was reluctant to go to her guest; perhaps she was feeling too cozy.
9.lessonText: Chie was reluctant to go to her guest; perhaps she was feeling too cozy.

clauses.text: Chie was reluctant to go to her guest;
perhaps she was feeling too cozy.

notes: 分号连接两个主句。reluctant to… 表不情愿；perhaps 保留叙述者对原因的推测，而不是绝对解释。

10.text: She and Naomi were reading at a low table set atop a charcoal brazier.
10.lessonText: She and Naomi were reading at a low table set atop a charcoal brazier.

clauses.text: She and Naomi were reading at a low table set atop a charcoal brazier.

notes: set 是过去分词，修饰 table，可释为 which was set…。它不是第二个过去式谓语；atop 相当于 on top of。

11.text: A thick quilt spread over the sides of the table so their legs were tucked inside with the heat.
11.lessonText: A thick quilt spread over the sides of the table so their legs were tucked inside with the heat.
functions: over the sides of the table

clauses.text: A thick quilt spread over the sides of the table
so their legs were tucked inside with the heat.

notes: spread 的过去式与原形相同，在此为主句谓语。so 连接结果分句；第二句被动说明双腿被被子围住保暖。

12.text: "Who is it at this hour, in this weather?"
12.lessonText: "Who is it at this hour, in this weather?"

clauses.text: "Who is it at this hour, in this weather?"

notes: 这是身份询问 Who is it?，两介词短语表惊讶的情境。本条和下一条属于同一段直接引语及报告内容，但保留已有音频划分。

13.text: Chie questioned as she picked the name card off the maid's lacquer tray.
13.lessonText: Chie questioned as she picked the name card off the maid's lacquer tray.

clauses.text: Chie questioned as she picked the name card off the maid's lacquer tray.
as she picked the name card off the maid's lacquer tray.

notes: questioned 承接上一条引语，在此是不带显式宾语的“问道”。as 表同时进行，off 表从表面取离。

clauses.text: "Shinoda, Akira.
clauses.label: Sentence fragment

notes: 名片上先姓后名，没有限定谓语，是朗读姓名片段，不强行当作完整陈述句。
本条只朗读姓名，使用 Sentence fragment 中性框，不添加不存在的谓语。

clauses.text: Kobe Dental College,"
clauses.label: Quoted fragment

clauses.text: she read.
clauses.label: Reporting clause

notes: 院校名称是名词短语，报告句 she read 是完整主句。read 在过去叙事中读 /red/；沿用原音频，分句不合并。
名片上的院校名单列 Quoted fragment；she read 是 Reporting clause，只有 read 用主句谓语色。

clauses.text: Naomi recognized the name.

notes: recognize 指认出曾知道的人或名字，不等于第一次学会读这个名字。

17.text: Chie heard a soft intake of air.
17.lessonText: Chie heard a soft intake of air.

clauses.text: Chie heard a soft intake of air.

notes: intake 是名词，a soft intake 指一次轻轻吸气；语境暗示 Naomi 的反应，不在语法上硬补作者未明写的主语。

18.text: "I think you should go," said Naomi.
18.lessonText: "I think you should go," said Naomi.

clauses.text: "I think you should go,"
clauses.label: Quoted main clause

clauses.text: you should go,
said Naomi.
clauses.label: Reporting clause

notes: 引语内 think 后省略 that。said Naomi 是报告句倒装；should 表建议，而非已经作出的安排。
引语主句 I think 与倒装报告句 said Naomi 分开；you should go 是嵌在引语内的 Object clause，that 为省略提示。

19.text: Akira was waiting in the entry.
19.lessonText: Akira was waiting in the entry.

clauses.text: Akira was waiting in the entry.

notes: entry 在此为入口／门厅空间，不是词条或报名记录。过去进行时说明她出来时正在持续的状态。

20.text: He was in his early twenties, slim and serious, wearing the black military-style uniform of a student.
20.lessonText: He was in his early twenties, slim and serious, wearing the black military-style uniform of a student.
functions: wearing the black military-style uniform of a student.

clauses.text: He was in his early twenties, slim and serious, wearing the black military-style uniform of a student.

notes: wearing 是附加的伴随分词，其逻辑主语为 He。in his early twenties 表二十出头，twenties 用复数。

21.text: As he bowed—his hands hanging straight down, a black cap in one, a yellow oil-paper umbrella in the other—Chie glanced beyond him.
21.lessonText: As he bowed—his hands hanging straight down, a black cap in one, a yellow oil-paper umbrella in the other—Chie glanced beyond him.

clauses.text: As he bowed—his hands hanging straight down, a black cap in one, a yellow oil-paper umbrella in the other—Chie glanced beyond him.
As he bowed—his hands hanging straight down, a black cap in one, a yellow oil-paper umbrella in the other—
his hands hanging straight down,
a black cap in one,
a yellow oil-paper umbrella in the other

notes: 破折号内描写鞠躬姿态。hanging 有自己的逻辑主语 hands；cap / umbrella 后省略位置状态的系词。主句直到 Chie glanced 才开始，不能把整段插入语当主句谓语。
As 时间从句包含三组独立补充结构；hands hanging 有非谓语动词，cap 和 umbrella 的位置说明没有原文限定系词。Chie glanced 才是主句主谓。

22.text: In the glistening surface of the courtyard's rain-drenched paving stones, she saw his reflection like a dark double.
22.lessonText: In the glistening surface of the courtyard's rain-drenched paving stones, she saw his reflection like a dark double.
functions: In the glistening surface of the courtyard's rain-drenched paving stones,

clauses.text: In the glistening surface of the courtyard's rain-drenched paving stones, she saw his reflection like a dark double.

notes: 长介词短语先交代倒影出现的位置；she 才是主语。glistening 和 rain-drenched 都修饰名词，不是新的限定谓语。

23.text: "Madame," said Akira, "forgive my disruption, but I come with a matter of urgency."
23.lessonText: "Madame," said Akira, "forgive my disruption, but I come with a matter of urgency."

clauses.text: "Madame,"
clauses.label: Vocative fragment

clauses.text: said Akira,
clauses.label: Reporting clause

clauses.text: "forgive my disruption,
clauses.label: Quoted main clause

clauses.text: but I come with a matter of urgency."
clauses.label: Quoted main clause

notes: Madame 是称呼语；forgive 省略主语 you，but 引出另一个明示主语 I 的句子。disruption 在此为冒昧打扰，不必译成严重破坏。
Madame 单列 Vocative fragment；said Akira 是 Reporting clause，后面两个引语主句分别是祈使请求与来意说明。

clauses.text: His voice was soft, refined.

notes: soft 和 refined 由逗号并置，共作表语。refined 描述教养与谈吐，不是音量“精炼”。

25.text: He straightened and stole a deferential peek at her face.
25.lessonText: He straightened and stole a deferential peek at her face.

clauses.text: He straightened and stole a deferential peek at her face.

notes: straightened 为不及物“直起身”。stole a peek 是悄悄看一眼；不是窃取某个实体物品。

26.text: In the dim light his eyes shone with sincerity.
26.lessonText: In the dim light his eyes shone with sincerity.

clauses.text: In the dim light his eyes shone with sincerity.

notes: shone 是 shine 的过去式。with sincerity 写眼神流露的态度，不是眼睛发光的物理燃料。

27.text: Chie felt herself starting to like him.
27.lessonText: Chie felt herself starting to like him.

clauses.text: Chie felt herself starting to like him.

notes: feel + 宾语 + -ing 描述感知到正在发生的变化。herself 是反身宾语，starting 并非另一个限定谓语。

28.text: "Come inside, get out of this nasty night.
28.lessonText: "Come inside, get out of this nasty night.

clauses.text: "Come inside, get out of this nasty night.

notes: 两个连续祈使动作共享隐含的 you。night 通过语境指夜间恶劣天气，come inside 是邀请，不是强硬命令。
get out 为动词部分，of 引出介词补足；保留连续祈使动作共用隐含 you 的分析。

29.text: Surely your business can wait for a moment or two."
29.lessonText: Surely your business can wait for a moment or two."

clauses.text: Surely your business can wait for a moment or two."

notes: business 是要办的事，不一定商业活动。Surely 带说话人的合理期待，中文可译“总……吧”。

clauses.text: "I don't want to trouble you.

notes: want 后接 to do，trouble 为及物动词“打扰”。一句简单礼貌表态，可快速带过。

31.text: Normally I would approach you more properly but I've received word of a position.
31.lessonText: Normally I would approach you more properly but I've received word of a position.

clauses.text: Normally I would approach you more properly
but I've received word of a position.

notes: would 配合 Normally 表通常情况下本会采取的方式。word 在 receive word of 中为“消息”，通常不可数，不是收到一个单词。
I’ve received 中 ’ve 为完成时助动词，和 received 一起构成谓语；主语 I 单独保留。

32.text: I've an opportunity to go to America, as dentist for Seattle's Japanese community."
32.lessonText: I've an opportunity to go to America, as dentist for Seattle's Japanese community."
functions: as dentist for Seattle's Japanese community."

clauses.text: I've an opportunity to go to America, as dentist for Seattle's Japanese community."

notes: I've 在此 = I have，have 是拥有，不是完成时助动词；后面没有过去分词。as dentist 表任职身份。
I’ve an opportunity 中 ’ve 是实义 have 的缩写，单独作谓语；与前句 I’ve received 的完成时用法区分。

clauses.text: "Congratulations,"
clauses.label: Quoted fragment

clauses.text: Chie said with amusement.
clauses.label: Reporting clause

notes: Congratulations 为固定复数祝贺语。with amusement 描写她轻松看待此事的态度，不必译成嘲笑。
Congratulations 是祝贺片段，不补造谓语；Chie said 为报告主句。

clauses.text: "That is an opportunity, I'm sure.
I'm sure.

notes: I'm sure 为句后评注，表达她对前述机会的认可；与正式用逗号把任意两个主句拼在一起的情况区分。
I’m sure 使用 Parenthetical comment，绿色标注评注结构；内部 ’m 是从属评注的系动词，用从句谓语色。

clauses.text: But how am I involved?"

notes: be involved 表卷入、与某事有关。how 询问参与关系，她此时尚不明白提亲意图。
此处采用状态分析：am 为系动词，involved 为描述参与关系的形容词性表语。

36.text: Even noting Naomi's breathless reaction to the name card, Chie had no idea.
36.lessonText: Even noting Naomi's breathless reaction to the name card, Chie had no idea.
functions: Even noting Naomi's breathless reaction to the name card,

clauses.text: Even noting Naomi's breathless reaction to the name card, Chie had no idea.

notes: noting 的逻辑主语是 Chie；Even 赋予让步义，但后面没有限定谓语。no idea 指不了解来意，不是完全没有思想。

37.text: Akira's message, delivered like a formal speech, filled her with maternal amusement.
37.lessonText: Akira's message, delivered like a formal speech, filled her with maternal amusement.

clauses.text: Akira's message, delivered like a formal speech, filled her with maternal amusement.

notes: delivered 修饰 message，主谓核心是 message filled。她把来客当孩子，是后面母女意愿冲突的伏笔。

38.text: You know how children speak so earnestly, so hurriedly, so endearingly about things that have no importance in an adult's mind?
38.lessonText: You know how children speak so earnestly, so hurriedly, so endearingly about things that have no importance in an adult's mind?
functions: so earnestly, so hurriedly, so endearingly

clauses.text: You know how children speak so earnestly, so hurriedly, so endearingly about things that have no importance in an adult's mind?
how children speak so earnestly, so hurriedly, so endearingly about things that have no importance in an adult's mind?
that have no importance in an adult's mind?

notes: 这是以陈述语序提问、邀请读者认同的问句。how 从句作 know 的宾语；that 指 things。所谓不重要是大人的看法，并非客观无价值。
how 宾语从句延伸至句末，并包含修饰 things 的 that 定语从句；两层分别显示。

39.text: That's how she viewed him, as a child.
39.lessonText: That's how she viewed him, as a child.

clauses.text: That's how she viewed him, as a child.
how she viewed him, as a child.

notes: how 从句说明看待方式；as a child 补足 viewed him 的身份判断，child 指 him，不是说她在孩童时期。
how she viewed him, as a child 整体作表语；as a child 说明宾语 him 被看作的身份，不是 she 的年龄状语。

40.text: It was how she viewed Naomi.
40.lessonText: It was how she viewed Naomi.

clauses.text: It was how she viewed Naomi.
how she viewed Naomi.

notes: It 指上句这种把年轻人当孩子的方式；how 从句作表语，不是时间从句。

41.text: Even though Naomi was eighteen and training endlessly in the arts needed to make a good marriage, Chie had made no effort to find her a husband.
41.lessonText: Even though Naomi was eighteen and training endlessly in the arts needed to make a good marriage, Chie had made no effort to find her a husband.
functions: needed to make a good marriage,

clauses.text: Even though Naomi was eighteen and training endlessly in the arts needed to make a good marriage, Chie had made no effort to find her a husband.
Even though Naomi was eighteen and training endlessly in the arts needed to make a good marriage,

notes: 从句 was 同时服务于 eighteen 和 (was) training，第二个 was 省略。needed 修饰 arts。find her a husband 为双宾语结构，her 是间接宾语。
was 在十八岁的状态和进行中的训练之间共享；training 作为省略第二个 was 的进行时谓语部分用从句色，needed 为修饰 arts 的非谓语。

clauses.text: Akira blushed.

notes: 不及物动词，主谓已完整。情绪通过动作呈现，不擅自断定一定是愤怒或羞耻。

43.text: "Depending on your response, I may stay in Japan.
43.lessonText: "Depending on your response, I may stay in Japan.

clauses.text: "Depending on your response, I may stay in Japan.

notes: Depending on 已常用作条件性附加表达，意为视……而定；原文没有 if 限定从句。may 保留不确定性。
Depending on… 保持条件性非谓语补充，不增加不存在的 If 从句框。

44.text: I've come to ask for Naomi's hand."
44.lessonText: I've come to ask for Naomi's hand."

clauses.text: I've come to ask for Naomi's hand."

notes: I've come = I have come，现在完成时；come 的过去分词仍是 come。ask for someone's hand 为传统提亲用语，不是要她的手这个身体部位。

45.text: Suddenly Chie felt the dampness of the night.
45.lessonText: Suddenly Chie felt the dampness of the night.

clauses.text: Suddenly Chie felt the dampness of the night.

notes: 感觉突然转向外界湿冷，映衬她心理上的震动；dampness 是名词，不是感觉“潮湿地”。

clauses.text: "Does Naomi know anything of your…ambitions?"

notes: know of 表知道某事。省略号表现停顿、措辞和怀疑，不表示这里缺少一个语法从句。

clauses.text: "We have an understanding.

notes: an understanding 可指非正式约定或共识；本文指 Akira 与 Naomi 已对婚事互有意愿，不是泛指理解能力。

48.text: Please don't judge my candidacy by the unseemliness of this proposal.
48.lessonText: Please don't judge my candidacy by the unseemliness of this proposal.
functions: by the unseemliness of this proposal.

clauses.text: Please don't judge my candidacy by the unseemliness of this proposal.

notes: 隐含主语 you。by 表评判标准；candidacy 与 proposal 使用正式语体，请她把人选与求婚方式区分。

49.text: I ask directly because the use of a go-between takes much time.
49.lessonText: I ask directly because the use of a go-between takes much time.

clauses.text: I ask directly because the use of a go-between takes much time.
because the use of a go-between takes much time.

notes: 原因从句主语中心 use 为单数，因此 takes。directly 指绕过中间人，不仅是说话不委婉。

50.text: Either method comes down to the same thing: a matter of parental approval.
50.lessonText: Either method comes down to the same thing: a matter of parental approval.

clauses.text: Either method comes down to the same thing: a matter of parental approval.

notes: either + 单数名词，谓语 comes。冒号后名词短语解释 thing，没有新谓语。to 是介词。

51.text: If you give your consent, I become Naomi's yoshi.
51.lessonText: If you give your consent, I become Naomi's yoshi.

clauses.text: If you give your consent, I become Naomi's yoshi.
If you give your consent,

notes: 真实条件的主句不强制用 will，become 可表获得许可后的直接结果。yoshi 为文本中的日语文化用语，指进入女方家庭并承其姓氏的女婿身份，勿机械当现代英语高频词。

52.text: We'll live in the House of Fuji.
52.lessonText: We'll live in the House of Fuji.

clauses.text: We'll live in the House of Fuji.

notes: House 首字母大写，含家族／家门意味；不只是一栋普通房屋。We'll = We will。

53.text: Without your consent, I must go to America, to secure a new home for my bride."
53.lessonText: Without your consent, I must go to America, to secure a new home for my bride."
functions: to secure a new home for my bride."

clauses.text: Without your consent, I must go to America, to secure a new home for my bride."

notes: without 后是名词，不是 if 从句。两个 to 不同：to America 是介词，to secure 是不定式。must 表情势所迫。

54.text: Eager to make his point, he'd been looking her full in the face.
54.lessonText: Eager to make his point, he'd been looking her full in the face.

clauses.text: Eager to make his point, he'd been looking her full in the face.

notes: he'd = he had，后接 been looking，为过去完成进行时。Eager 为形容词短语，逻辑主语是 he；full 在固定表达中为副词性“直直地”。
he’d been looking 为 he had been looking；主语 he 与谓语链 ’d been looking 分开。

clauses.text: Abruptly, his voice turned gentle.

notes: turn 在此为系动词，后接形容词 gentle，不用 gently。abruptly 修饰变化发生得突然，不指他的态度变粗鲁。

clauses.text: "I see I've startled you.
I've startled you.

notes: see 表意识到；宾语从句省略 that。I've startled 强调此前言语对她造成的当前影响。

clauses.text: My humble apologies.
clauses.label: Sentence fragment

notes: 固定礼貌表达，可释为 Please accept my apologies，但原文没有这个谓语。apologies 为复数，不强行分主谓宾。
My humble apologies 为名词片段；保留中文礼貌释义，不把 Please accept… 写入原文。

58.text: I'll take no more of your evening.
58.lessonText: I'll take no more of your evening.

clauses.text: I'll take no more of your evening.

notes: take 在此为占用时间。no more of 指不再占用更多，不是拒绝再拿取一个晚上。

59.text: My address is on my card.
59.lessonText: My address is on my card.

clauses.text: My address is on my card.

notes: on 表印在卡片表面。简短主系表句，可快速核对。

60.text: If you don't wish to contact me, I'll reapproach you in two weeks' time.
60.lessonText: If you don't wish to contact me, I'll reapproach you in two weeks' time.

clauses.text: If you don't wish to contact me, I'll reapproach you in two weeks' time.
If you don't wish to contact me,

notes: if 从句用现在时谈将来条件；主句 will。two weeks' time 的所有格撇号在复数 s 后。reapproach 指再次接洽。

clauses.text: Until then, good night."
clauses.label: Sentence fragment

notes: 没有限定谓语，是礼貌告别的省略表达；不标成 until 引导的时间从句。
Until then 后接的是副词 then，而非有限定谓语的从句；整条使用 Sentence fragment。

clauses.text: He bowed and left.

notes: 两个谓语共享 He。bow 鞠躬读 /baʊ/，不是蝴蝶结 bow /bəʊ/；这里只作发音提示，原音频不变。

63.text: Taking her ease, with effortless grace, like a cat making off with a fish.
63.lessonText: Taking her ease, with effortless grace, like a cat making off with a fish.

clauses.text: Taking her ease, with effortless grace, like a cat making off with a fish.
clauses.label: Sentence fragment

notes: 全文语境支持 Taking 承接前句 He（Akira），her 指 Chie：他带走她的安宁，像猫叼走鱼。讲义把它当作 Chie 悠闲休息会错置主体。此为文学断句，没有限定谓语，解释属基于上下文的阅读判断。
Taking… 为承接前文的文学分词片段，主体解读仍保留在中文说明中；Taking 和 making off 都不标为限定谓语。

clauses.text: "Mother?"
clauses.label: Sentence fragment

notes: 用疑问语调轻声呼唤，没有主谓结构；下一条报告句说明这是 Naomi 的声音。
Mother? 是称呼片段，不强行补成疑问主句。

65.text: Chie heard Naomi's low voice and turned from the door.
65.lessonText: Chie heard Naomi's low voice and turned from the door.

clauses.text: Chie heard Naomi's low voice and turned from the door.

notes: heard 与 turned 共用主语 Chie；low 描述声音轻低，不指说话者地位低。

clauses.text: "He has asked you?"

notes: 用陈述语序表达吃惊和确认；不是所有英语问句都必须助动词倒装。ask you 的具体内容由婚事语境补出。

67.text: The sight of Naomi's clear eyes, her dark brows gave Chie strength.
67.lessonText: The sight of Naomi's clear eyes, her dark brows gave Chie strength.
functions: The sight of Naomi's clear eyes, her dark brows

clauses.text: The sight of Naomi's clear eyes, her dark brows gave Chie strength.

notes: 主语中心是 sight。eyes 与 brows 并列作 of 的对象，逗号形成列举；不是两个并列主语。give someone something 为双宾语结构。

clauses.text: Maybe his hopes were preposterous.

notes: his 指 Akira。Maybe 保留 Chie 自我安慰式的不确定；不是作者无条件宣布他的想法可笑。

69.text: "Where did you meet such a fellow?
69.lessonText: "Where did you meet such a fellow?

clauses.text: "Where did you meet such a fellow?

notes: did 后 meet 用原形。such a fellow 带说话人的态度，不只是中性的 a person。

clauses.text: Imagine!

notes: 完整的单词祈使句，主语 you 省略，宾语从上下文可知；不同于没有谓语的称呼片段。
Imagine! 本身是完整祈使句，使用主句谓语色；与无谓语的称呼片段区别。

71.text: He thinks he can marry the Fuji heir and take her to America all in the snap of his fingers!"
71.lessonText: He thinks he can marry the Fuji heir and take her to America all in the snap of his fingers!"
functions: to America all in the snap of his fingers!"

clauses.text: He thinks he can marry the Fuji heir and take her to America all in the snap of his fingers!"
he can marry the Fuji heir and take her to America all in the snap of his fingers!"

notes: 宾语从句的 marry 与 take 共享 he can。Fuji heir 为 Naomi；her 亦指 Naomi。in the snap of his fingers 夸张地表示轻易迅速，并非精确时长。
think 后省略 that；can marry 与 take 同在宾语从句内，均用从句谓语色，to America 仍为地点状语。

72.text: Chie waited for Naomi's ripe laughter.
72.lessonText: Chie waited for Naomi's ripe laughter.

clauses.text: Chie waited for Naomi's ripe laughter.

notes: ripe laughter 为文学描写，意为饱满、酣畅的笑声。她预期女儿同自己一起觉得荒唐，后文的沉默却打破期待。

clauses.text: Naomi was silent.

notes: silent 是形容词。简单短句与母亲等待笑声形成明显反差。

74.text: She stood a full half minute looking straight into Chie's eyes.
74.lessonText: She stood a full half minute looking straight into Chie's eyes.

clauses.text: She stood a full half minute looking straight into Chie's eyes.

notes: a full half minute 为时长名词短语；looking 的逻辑主语为 She，描写同时持续的目光。full 加强“整整”。

clauses.text: Finally, she spoke.

notes: spoke 为 speak 的过去式；短句延缓揭晓她的回答，形成叙事停顿。

76.text: "I met him at my literary meeting."
76.lessonText: "I met him at my literary meeting."

clauses.text: "I met him at my literary meeting."

notes: 英文是普通主谓宾加地点状语；中文可自然译“是在……”，不能据此误判英文为 It was…that 强调句。

77.text: Naomi turned to go back into the house, then stopped.
77.lessonText: Naomi turned to go back into the house, then stopped.
functions: to go back into the house,

clauses.text: Naomi turned to go back into the house, then stopped.

notes: turned 与 stopped 共享主语 Naomi。to go 表转身的目的，不保证动作最终完成；stopped 之后的停顿引出决定。

clauses.text: "Mother."
clauses.label: Sentence fragment

notes: 再次呼唤母亲，以句号落定语气。没有限定谓语，与前面问号式呼唤的语气不同。
Mother. 是称呼片段；保留句号及与前一次呼唤不同的语气。

clauses.text: "Yes?"
clauses.label: Sentence fragment

notes: Yes? 在此示意“我在听，说吧”，不是对婚事给予正式同意；不要脱离对话顺序误读。
Yes? 为回应片段，不能按语法标签推定人物已经同意婚事。

clauses.text: "I mean to have him."

notes: mean to do 表打算、决意；mean doing 表意味着，不能混用。have him 结合婚事语境是选择与他成婚，不按占有物品理解；简短句表达坚定意愿。
